title: YouTube transcript API: official limits and real options
snippet:
YouTube has no official API that returns the transcript of any video. The YouTube Data API's captions.download method costs 200 quota units and requires permission to edit the video, so it only works on videos you manage. For public videos, developers use the unofficial youtube-transcript-api Python library, which YouTube often blocks on cloud servers, or a paid service such as Supadata (1 credit per transcript, plans from $5 a month billed yearly) or Scrape Creators, which sells prepaid credit packs.

Google states that captions.download requires the user to have permission to edit the video. The call needs OAuth with the youtube.force-ssl or youtubepartner scope. On someone else’s video it returns 403 forbidden.

| Option | Works on | Price | Main catch |
|---|---|---|---|
| YouTube Data API captions | Videos you can edit | Free within 10,000 quota units a day | Owner permission and OAuth required |
| youtube-transcript-api (Python) | Public videos with captions | Free, MIT license | Uses an undocumented endpoint. YouTube blocks most cloud provider IPs, so production use needs rotating residential proxies. |
| Supadata | YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X videos | 100 free credits a month. Basic $5 a month billed yearly for 300 credits, Pro $17 for 3,000. 1 credit per transcript. | Monthly credits do not roll over. AI-generated transcripts cost 2 credits per minute. |
| Scrape Creators | YouTube and other social platforms | 100 free credits, then prepaid credit packs that cost less per credit as they get larger | Age-restricted videos return 403. Purchased credits never expire. |
| Gemini API with a YouTube URL | Public videos only | Preview feature that Google lists at no charge for now | The model writes the text from the video. Free-tier projects are capped at 8 hours of YouTube video a day. |

title: YouTube Transcript API – Request Access | Transcriptube
snippet:
# YouTube Transcript API
Programmatic access to YouTube transcripts for your own applications.
The same engine that powers the tools on this site is available for developers. It takes a YouTube video ID and returns the full transcript as structured data: every spoken line with its start time and duration. Use it to feed transcripts into your app, pipeline or research project without scraping YouTube yourself.
Access is granted individually. Tell us what you are building and how many videos you expect to process, and we will reply by email with the details.

title: YouTube Transcript API Docs: Endpoints, Examples & MCP
snippet:
## Quickstart
Create a key, then request a transcript by URL or video ID:
```
curl "https://transcript-yt.com/v1/transcript?url=5f3Pn-N6yLc" \
-H "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxx"
```
## AI agents (MCP)
Connect TranscriptYT to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, or Claude Desktop through our MCP server at `https://transcript-yt.com/mcp`. The one-click installs sign you in; in the snippets below, replace `ts_live_...` with your key.
```
claude mcp add --transport http transcriptyt https://transcript-yt.com/mcp \
--header "Authorization: Bearer ts_live_..."
```

- `list_playlist_videos`: videos in a playlist or a channel's uploads. Free on paid plans; Free plan: 10 a day, then 1 credit.
- `search_youtube`: search YouTube, or within one channel. Free on paid plans; Free plan: 10 a day, then 1 credit.
- `get_usage`: remaining credits. Free.
## Authentication
Pass your key as a bearer token. `x-api-key` also works if a header library makes that easier.
```
Authorization: Bearer ts_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
